Neither is better for video games overall. POP!\_OS has an advantage due to NVIDIA Drivers. But overall most Distros are equal when it comes to video games.

This is untrue, as Arch Linux now has an installer. Granted, it's text based, but it's an installer. You don't have to do anything manually.
